question.html:
A rod is formed from two metal rods XY and YZ of identical dimensions. End X and end Z are at different temperatures.

a The side of the rod can be unlagged or ideally lagged. Explain the difference in energy transfer for these two cases. [3]

b Rod XYZ is ideally lagged. The thermal conductivity of XY is k and the thermal conductivity of YZ is 2k. End X is at 90 °C and end Z is at 45 °C

b.i Calculate the temperature at Y. [3]

b.ii The temperatures are now reversed so that X is at 45 °C and Z is at 90 °C. Show that the rate of energy transfer is unchanged. [2]
